answer: A fresh key is bare copper, bright but unweathered: it carries no sealed grading history. In this economy weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus, so none can be minted or handed over. Trust climbs slow as a vine up a juniper, one honest epoch at a time; a hundred clones must each repay a hundred times the judgment labor, so the Sybil bill grows linearly in identities, never shared.
